topic: Database version rollback and stability issues
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on rolling back the application version due to database errors. Initially, [p1] attempted deploying v24.5.1.1763-stable and later v24.4.2.141-stable, but both resulted in `DB::Exception` errors related to the structure of the `allunite.captive_user_event_agg_sharded` table (specifically concerning using `SimpleAggregateFunction(min, DateTime)` in the primary key). After troubleshooting and rolling back the schema definition, [me] advised reverting to a previous stable version. Eventually, after multiple attempts across versions 24.4 and 24.1, deploying version 24.1.3.31 (or matching the production version of 24.1.5.6) successfully resolved the deployment failure.
decisions: The application was rolled back to a stable version (specifically v24.1.3.31 or equivalent to production's 24.1.5.6) to resolve database connection and load job errors.
